chunks: Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said to Abū Baṣīr: “Whatever they may deceive you about, let them not deceive you concerning the ‘Asr prayer. Perform it while the sun is still white and clear, for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: ‘The one deprived of his family and wealth is the one who neglects the ‘Asr prayer.’”
It was said: “What does it mean, deprived of his family and wealth?” He said: “He will have no family and no wealth in Paradise.”
It was said: “What is neglecting it?” He said: “By Allah, it is that he leaves it until the sun turns yellow or the sun sets.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of reward in the Hereafter
key_terms.بَيْضَاءُ نَقِيَّةٌ: white and clear, describing the preferable state of the sun when ‘Asr should be performed
key_terms.تَصْفَرَّ: to become yellow, referring to the late time of the sun
key_terms.تَضْيِيعُهَا: neglecting it, failing to observe the prayer properly in time
key_terms.ضَيَّعَ: neglected or allowed to be lost

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about delaying the ‘Asr prayer until late afternoon?
ai.summary: This hadith stresses the importance of performing the ‘Asr prayer within its proper time and warns against delaying it until the sun yellows or sets. It also links neglect of this prayer with deprivation in the Hereafter, showing both the legal and spiritual gravity of guarding salat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.654 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said to Abu Basir:
"Whatever they may deceive you about, do not let them deceive you about the Asr prayer. Perform it while the sun is still white and clear, for the Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
'The one deprived of his family and wealth is the one who neglects the Asr prayer.'
He was asked: 'What does it mean to be deprived of one's family and wealth?'
Imam (as) said: 'It means that he will have no family or wealth in Paradise.'
He was asked: 'What does it mean to neglect it?'
Imam (as) said: 'By Allah (swt), it means leaving it until the sun turns yellow or sets.'"
